name: incorrect_lib_condition_again_beb375a9
subject: Fix incorrect lib condition again! (#58945)
not_strict_reasons: no failing case added by the fix

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Fixes an incorrect noLib condition in isSourceFileDefaultLibrary and guards against a missing resolved lib reference (non-null assertion) when a root file has no-default-lib. Affects tsbuild/watch library resolution results.
